_meta.purpose: Makes carmind recognises in the request text: on the chat route with no identified vehicle, a make listed here other than Skoda gets the unsupported-vehicle reply, and with an identified car, on any route, naming a listed make other than the car's gets the mismatch reply (serve/README.md "Vehicle resolution" has the exact rules).
